Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of G5115; to shoot down with an arrow or other missile:--thrust through.
BiblicalUsage: This word has no occurrence anywhere in the Greek New Testament, and no verse in the New Testament carries it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a word with no verse to stand on should be said so plainly, and I will not invent a passage to fill the gap.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
